title: Fear recedes in humble company
summary: This meets the alarmed state that tries to survive by closing in on itself. The line says safety grows where the humble gather and the Merciful One settles in the mind.
takeaway: Go where humility makes fear smaller.
lifeApplication: When the body goes tight and solitary, go sit near the humble person, the sangat, or the elder whose presence steadies you. Let company calm what panic is inflating.

source.shortMeaning: Humble company makes room for the Merciful One to settle the mind.
source.lifeApplication: When fear narrows you, move toward company that carries mercy instead of panic.

evidence.turn: Move toward the humble until fear loses its command.
